meaning: Compose the existing typed immutableIsBoethianEternal theorem with the explicit one-way recognition transfer to the EXACT all-beings ImmutableIsEternalReading root premise. Succession-to-subject-potency, boundary-to-subject-potency, and pure-act-has-life stay separately visible. No inference from immutable to alive is hidden in a definition.

strong_version_needed.STMT-LIFE-BOUNDARY-REQUIRES-POTENCY: Its pure-act conclusion quantifies over potency in the subject (MUTABLE_1), so the boundary premise is needed in that sense; the weaker MUTABLE_3 reading STMT-LIFE-BOUNDARY-REQUIRES-SOME-MUTABILITY reaches it only with the open bridge STMT-SUBJECT-OF-ANOTHERS-POWER-HAS-POTENCY (LIFE-BOUNDARY-POTENCY-FROM-SOME-MUTABILITY; batch 4 of #1233).
